Represented bony fish groups 14–42 form the broad composition proxy; dedicated shark, ray/skate and torpedo pools 13 and 43–47 are excluded. Mixed NC large pelagic 14 remains eligible through source-listed Mola mola; Cetorhinus maximus and Mobula mobular are outside target scope, so full pooled source quantities retain an unobserved-composition mismatch. Residual taxonomic composition, unrepresented taxa and wider-region transfer remain unobserved; membership and overall confidence remain Very low.
